name: smwgraphics-the-great-giana-sisters
title: The Great Giana Sisters
description:
Submitted during Summer C3 2021!

This is a rip of a font used in Armin Gessert's The Great Giana Sisters. Although the original font only contained uppercase letters, numbers, and some punctuation, it has been expanded to include lowercase letters based on the TrueType font "Giana" by KreativeKorp. An alternate set of numerals is also included.
